comparison_a.label: Banco Bradesco S.A. vs BCP Stand-alone
caveats: Currencies differ (BRL vs PEN) — must convert or compare ratios, not absolute values.
Market sizes differ radically (Brazil GDP ≈ 10× Peru GDP).
Comparability requires metric normalization (market share, ROAE, efficiency) rather than absolute scale.

comparison_b.label: Organização Bradesco vs Credicorp (group-level)
caveats: Both are multi-business holdings (banking + insurance + digital).
Asymmetry of market scale persists at group level.
Useful for structural comparison (business-mix), not for absolute-size ranking.
